## Method {#sec-method}

The loss is @eq-loss. The rungs are in @tbl-rungs.

$$
L = \sum_i (y_i - \hat y_i)^2
$$ {#eq-loss}

| Rung | Holds |
|---|---|
| `L0` | the ball |
| `L1` | the players |
| `L2` | the window |

: The rungs {#tbl-rungs}

::: {.callout-note}
The rungs are strictly nested.
